description: This file defines a PHP class 'Html' that extends 'BaseReader' for importing HTML content into a PhpSpreadsheet object. It includes methods for parsing HTML DOM elements, applying inline styles, managing tables, and handling embedded images, as well as methods for validating HTML files and extracting properties.

classes.name: Html
classes.description: A class for importing HTML content into PhpSpreadsheet, supporting parsing of HTML DOM elements, inline styles, images, and properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Html reader and sets up security scanning.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Validates whether a file is an HTML file based on its content start, tags, and end tags.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromFile
methods.description: Loads a spreadsheet from an HTML file.

methods.name: setInputEncoding
methods.description: Deprecated method to set input encoding; no longer used.

methods.name: getInputEncoding
methods.description: Deprecated method to get input encoding.

methods.name: loadFromString
methods.description: Loads a Spreadsheet from a string containing HTML content.

methods.name: loadIntoExisting
methods.description: Loads HTML content into an existing Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: setSheetIndex
methods.description: Sets the sheet index to load.

methods.name: loadProperties
methods.description: Extracts metadata properties from HTML meta tags and applies them to the Spreadsheet.

methods.name: loadDocument
methods.description: Loads a DOMDocument into a Spreadsheet, processing HTML elements into spreadsheet cells.

methods.name: replaceNonAscii
methods.description: Replaces non-ASCII characters with numeric character references.

methods.name: getBorderMappings
methods.description: Returns the array mapping CSS border styles to PhpSpreadsheet border styles.

methods.name: getBorderStyle
methods.description: Maps an HTML border style string to a PhpSpreadsheet border style.

methods.name: applyInlineStyle
methods.description: Applies inline CSS styles (like background-color, font, border, etc.) to a cell or range based on the style attribute.

methods.name: getStyleColor
methods.description: Converts color names or hex codes to RGB strings.

methods.name: insertImage
methods.description: Inserts an image into a worksheet cell based on 'src' attribute.

methods.name: processDomElement
methods.description: Recursively processes DOM nodes to translate HTML structure into spreadsheet cells.
